name: Pigeon Hag

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.summary: With two hag allies within 30 ft, casts one of Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm or Unseen Servant, each once per Long Rest.
traits.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm (which lasts until she casts it again or ends it with no action) or Unseen Servant, with no Material components, the normal casting time, and Intelligence as her spellcasting ability. After casting one of them this way she must finish a Long Rest before she can cast that spell with this trait again.

traits.name: Disarming Vanity
traits.summary: Flattering her (Influence action) forces a DC 17 Cha save, or she is Incapacitated until the end of her next turn.
traits.text: As an Influence action, a creature that flatters the hag forces her to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be Incapacitated until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Out the Window
traits.summary: With her action she flings a Paralyzed or Restrained creature next to a window out of it.
traits.text: Her favourite trick: she holds a foe still with a spell, then heaves them out through the nearest window, to fall to the ground below.

traits.name: Harrying Wings
traits.summary: From the moment she rolls Initiative, enemies within 10 ft have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls (not while she is Incapacitated).
traits.text: When the hag rolls Initiative, angry pigeon-spirits whirl around her. Her enemies within a 10-foot Emanation have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. The wings do nothing while she has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Claw attacks; one can be an at-will spell.
actions.text: The hag makes three Claw attacks. She can replace one of them with Spellcasting, using at-will spells only.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Claws that tear flesh and mind: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Agonizing Cackle
actions.summary: 1/Day. 60-ft cone, DC 19 Wis save: 10d8 Psychic (half on a success) and Incapacitated until her next turn on a failure.
actions.text: Wisdom save, DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 45 (10d8) Psychic damage and the target is Incapacitated until the start of the hag's next turn. Success: half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Charisma, DC 19: Command (level 2), Hold Person, Minor Illusion, Stinking Cloud at will; Befuddlement, Dominate Person, Scrying, Word of Recall once a day each.
actions.text: The hag casts one of these spells, needing no Material components and using Charisma (spell save DC 19). At will: Command (level 2 version), Hold Person, Minor Illusion, Stinking Cloud. 1/day each: Befuddlement, Dominate Person, Scrying, Word of Recall (her lair as the sanctuary).

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the form of a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to her true form.
bonus_actions.text: The hag turns into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics stay the same in every form except her size. Equipment she wears or carries doesn't change with her.

shapes.name: Disguise
shapes.summary: The Humanoid she passes as (a Small or Medium villager): her statistics stay the same.

summary: A vain, scheming fey hag who passes among villagers, then claws and cackles, bends minds with spells and flaps a ward of pigeons.
